{"schema_version":"company_profile_workpaper_draft.v1","elements":{"business_structure":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F01","text":"公司主营业务为服装服饰类产品的研发、设计、生产和销售，业务模式未发生重大变化；按面向市场和经营模式不同，分为国外市场的外贸生产加工和国内市场品牌生产加工销售。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004"]},{"fact_id":"F02","text":"公司在国内开展服装全链条业务，涵盖生产加工与终端销售，主营自主品牌男装、女装及各类配套服饰；国内市场构建零售、团购定制、线上网购相结合的多元化营销体系。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004"]},{"fact_id":"F03","text":"外贸加工业务主要采用来料加工、进料加工和一般贸易三种运营模式，形成以来料加工、进料加工为主的外贸业务格局，并在稳固日本、东南亚等传统加工贸易市场的同时拓展海外一般贸易业务。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004"]}],"limitations":[]},"products_services":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F04","text":"美尔雅男装品类齐全，包含西服、衬衣、毛衫、T恤、大衣、休闲服及裤装等，定位中高档商务政务男装；“美尔雅”西服为传统核心产品，获评“中国驰名商标”及“中国服装年度大奖——品质大奖”，在内销业务中占据主导地位。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004"]},{"fact_id":"F05","text":"美尔雅女装分为职业装、礼服、时装、休闲装四大系列，主要面向职业女性，主打商务时尚风格。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004"]},{"fact_id":"F06","text":"团购定制主要承接各类团体服装加工与定制业务，服务金融、电力、电信、政府机构、学校及各类企事业单位。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004"]}],"limitations":[]},"revenue_model":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F07","text":"主营业务分产品收入构成：品牌男装营业收入129,735,100.43元，品牌女装52,701,247.53元，出口加工类46,761,060.90元，其他业务6,997,591.25元，小计236,195,000.11元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0008","source-0009"],"metrics":[{"name":"品牌男装营业收入","raw_value":"129,735,100.43","value":"129735100.43","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"品牌女装营业收入","raw_value":"52,701,247.53","value":"52701247.53","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"出口加工类营业收入","raw_value":"46,761,060.90","value":"46761060.90","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他业务营业收入","raw_value":"6,997,591.25","value":"6997591.25","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"主营业务分产品小计营业收入","raw_value":"236,195,000.11","value":"236195000.11","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F08","text":"主营业务分行业收入构成：服装营业收入229,197,408.86元，其他业务6,997,591.25元，小计236,195,000.11元；医疗行业本期无列示营业收入。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0008"],"metrics":[{"name":"服装行业营业收入","raw_value":"229,197,408.86","value":"229197408.86","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他业务营业收入","raw_value":"6,997,591.25","value":"6997591.25","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"主营业务分行业小计营业收入","raw_value":"236,195,000.11","value":"236195000.11","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F09","text":"主营业务分销售模式收入构成：直营店56,431,306.80元，加盟联营店75,185,231.39元，出口加工46,761,060.90元，其他业务57,817,401.02元，小计236,195,000.11元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0009"],"metrics":[{"name":"直营店营业收入","raw_value":"56,431,306.80","value":"56431306.80","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"加盟联营店营业收入","raw_value":"75,185,231.39","value":"75185231.39","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"出口加工营业收入","raw_value":"46,761,060.90","value":"46761060.90","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他业务营业收入","raw_value":"57,817,401.02","value":"57817401.02","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"主营业务分销售模式小计营业收入","raw_value":"236,195,000.11","value":"236195000.11","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]}],"limitations":["分产品表中“医疗”行未列示营业收入金额，仅列示同比-100.00%，未据此推断为零收入。"]},"scale_and_mix":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F10","text":"报告期内公司整体实现营业收入23,619.50万元，同比下降28.32%；实现归属于母公司所有者的净利润-8,909.26万元，同比下降30.82%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0006"],"metrics":[{"name":"营业收入","raw_value":"23,619.50","value":"23619.50","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"营业收入同比增减","raw_value":"-28.32","value":"-28.32","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"归属于母公司所有者的净利润","raw_value":"-8,909.26","value":"-8909.26","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"归属于母公司所有者的净利润同比增减","raw_value":"-30.82","value":"-30.82","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F11","text":"2025年营业收入236,195,000.11元，2024年调整后329,501,963.16元，本期比上年同期减少28.32%；2025年营业成本153,689,576.55元，上年同期223,242,612.14元，减少31.16%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001","source-0007","source-0008"],"metrics":[{"name":"营业收入","raw_value":"236,195,000.11","value":"236195000.11","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"营业收入（上年同期）","raw_value":"329,501,963.16","value":"329501963.16","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2024年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"营业成本","raw_value":"153,689,576.55","value":"153689576.55","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"营业成本（上年同期）","raw_value":"223,242,612.14","value":"223242612.14","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2024年度","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F12","text":"主营业务分行业毛利率：服装35.26%，其他业务24.14%，小计34.93%；服装毛利率比上年增加0.12个百分点。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0008"],"metrics":[{"name":"服装行业毛利率","raw_value":"35.26","value":"35.26","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他业务毛利率","raw_value":"24.14","value":"24.14","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"主营业务分行业小计毛利率","raw_value":"34.93","value":"34.93","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"服装行业毛利率比上年增减","raw_value":"0.12","value":"0.12","unit":"百分点","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]}],"limitations":[]},"operations_and_inputs":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F13","text":"产销量情况：美尔雅品牌男装生产量659,689.00件/套、销售量815,915.00件/套、库存量701,810.00件/套；美尔雅品牌女装生产量628,976.00件/套、销售量669,828.00件/套、库存量439,802.00件/套；合计生产量1,288,665.00件/套、销售量1,485,743.00件/套、库存量1,141,612.00件/套。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0009","source-0010"],"metrics":[{"name":"美尔雅品牌男装生产量","raw_value":"659,689.00","value":"659689.00","unit":"件/套","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"美尔雅品牌男装销售量","raw_value":"815,915.00","value":"815915.00","unit":"件/套","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"美尔雅品牌女装生产量","raw_value":"628,976.00","value":"628976.00","unit":"件/套","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"美尔雅品牌女装销售量","raw_value":"669,828.00","value":"669828.00","unit":"件/套","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"合计生产量","raw_value":"1,288,665.00","value":"1288665.00","unit":"件/套","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"合计销售量","raw_value":"1,485,743.00","value":"1485743.00","unit":"件/套","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F14","text":"成本构成：服装营业成本148,381,101.41元，占本期总成本96.55%；其他业务营业成本5,308,475.14元，占3.45%；小计153,689,576.55元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0010"],"metrics":[{"name":"服装营业成本","raw_value":"148,381,101.41","value":"148381101.41","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"服装营业成本占总成本比例","raw_value":"96.55","value":"96.55","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他业务营业成本","raw_value":"5,308,475.14","value":"5308475.14","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"营业成本小计","raw_value":"153,689,576.55","value":"153689576.55","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]}],"limitations":["研发投入情况表标注为不适用，未获取研发投入金额。"]},"customers_channels_markets":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F15","text":"国内零售以直营店、加盟店、商场专柜为主要形式；网购渠道依托京东、天猫、抖音等平台，销售与线下门店差异化的产品。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004"]},{"fact_id":"F16","text":"报告期内实体门店：美尔雅品牌直营店2024年末31家、2025年末33家，新开3家、关闭1家；加盟联营店2024年末121家、2025年末103家，新开2家、关闭20家；合计2024年末152家、2025年末136家，新开5家、关闭21家。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0015"],"metrics":[{"name":"美尔雅品牌直营店2025年末数量","raw_value":"33","value":"33","unit":"家","currency":null,"subj facts.text: 公司主营业务为服装服饰类产品的研发、设计、生产和销售，业务模式未发生重大变化；按面向市场和经营模式不同，分为国外市场的外贸生产加工和国内市场品牌生产加工销售。
公司在国内开展服装全链条业务，涵盖生产加工与终端销售，主营自主品牌男装、女装及各类配套服饰；国内市场构建零售、团购定制、线上网购相结合的多元化营销体系。
外贸加工业务主要采用来料加工、进料加工和一般贸易三种运营模式，形成以来料加工、进料加工为主的外贸业务格局，并在稳固日本、东南亚等传统加工贸易市场的同时拓展海外一般贸易业务。
美尔雅男装品类齐全，包含西服、衬衣、毛衫、T恤、大衣、休闲服及裤装等，定位中高档商务政务男装；“美尔雅”西服为传统核心产品，获评“中国驰名商标”及“中国服装年度大奖——品质大奖”，在内销业务中占据主导地位。
美尔雅女装分为职业装、礼服、时装、休闲装四大系列，主要面向职业女性，主打商务时尚风格。
团购定制主要承接各类团体服装加工与定制业务，服务金融、电力、电信、政府机构、学校及各类企事业单位。
